uzmanAsistanlar.aciklama: Consult AI assistants specialised in SEO, advertising, social media, content and branding.
uzmanAsistanlar.atif: Assistant definitions are adapted from the {{ad}} project ({{lisans}}).
uzmanAsistanlar.asistanYok: No assistants are available right now.
uzmanAsistanlar.karsilama: A new chat with {{ad}}. Start with a sample question or type your own.
uzmanAsistanlar.yaziyor: The assistant is preparing a reply…
uzmanAsistanlar.yerTutucu: Type your question (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line)
uzmanAsistanlar.uyari: Replies are generated by AI and may be wrong; consult an expert for important decisions. Do not share passwords or card details.

hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again a little later.
hata.gecersiz: The information sent is not valid.
hata.cok_hizli: You are sending messages too quickly; wait a minute and try again.
hata.gunluk_sinir: You have used today's messages. You can continue tomorrow.
hata.kredi_yetersiz: Your credit balance is too low ({{gerekli}} credits per message). You can buy credits from the My credits tab.
hata.ai_kapali: The assistant is unavailable right now. Your message was saved; please try again later.
hata.ai_hatasi: The assistant could not reply. Your message was saved and no credit was charged; you can try again.
hata.ai_zaman_asimi: The reply took too long. Your message was saved; you can try again.
hata.ai_bos: The assistant returned an empty reply. You can try again.
hata.yanitsiz: Your last message has no reply yet. You can try again.
hata.bos_mesaj: An empty message cannot be sent.
hata.modul_kapali: Expert Assistants are not enabled for your account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You do not have permission to use assistants in this account.
hata.hesap_uyesi_degil: You are not a member of this account.
hata.zorunlu: A required field was left empty.

yonetim.aciklama: Enable or disable assistants, edit their texts in 7 languages and their system prompts, try them out and monitor usage.
yonetim.modulNotu: The module is enabled per client from the Modules tab (off by default). A client-specific daily limit can also be set there.
yonetim.acikButce: Public endpoints: total daily requests (0 = unlimited)
yonetim.ayarIpucu: If the model is empty, the default is used. Public endpoints: the home page discovery assistant and the site chat; also limited to 30 requests per hour and 100 per day per IP.
yonetim.toplam: {{mesaj}} replies in total · tokens {{giris}} in / {{cikis}} out
yonetim.sistemIstemi: System prompt (server only; clients never see it)
yonetim.istemIpucu: Common safety rules are appended on the server to every call.
yonetim.denemeNotu: A test just for you: no chat or message is saved and client counters are not affected.
